Simulated 24-hour time-use dataset

Source: R/data.R
timeuse.Rd

A simulated dataset of daily movement-behaviour compositions for 300 individuals, used in place of real data by the timecoda examples and tests. The four behaviour parts sum exactly to 1440 minutes (24 h) for every individual, and the outcomes are generated with a compositional effect (more moderate-to-vigorous activity and sleep lower adiposity; more sedentary time raises it).

Usage

timeuse

Format

A data frame with 300 rows and 13 variables:

id

Participant identifier ("p001" to "p300").

sex

Grouping factor, "female"/"male" (for ternary colouring and as a covariate).

school

Clustering factor with 10 levels ("school01" to "school10"), for multilevel/mixed (lme4) models.

region

Coarser clustering factor with 3 levels ("A"/"B"/"C") that nests school deterministically (schools 01 to 03 in "A", 04 to 06 in "B", 07 to 10 in "C"), for a model with several random intercepts (random = c("region", "school")).

MVPA

Moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (minutes/day).

LPA

Light physical activity (minutes/day).

SB

Sedentary behaviour (minutes/day).

SPT

Sleep period time (minutes/day).

zbmi

Continuous outcome: body-mass-index z-score.

obesity

Binary outcome factor, "no"/"yes".

time

Survival outcome: follow-up time, in months, to onset of obesity or censoring.

event

Survival outcome: obesity-onset indicator (1 = onset, 0 = censored).

grade

Ordinal outcome: an ordered academic-achievement band, "below" < "expected" < "above" (tertiles of a composition-driven latent score). Used by the ordinal model path and, coerced to an unordered factor, by the multinomial path.

Source

Simulated; see data-raw/timeuse.R for the generating script and random seed.

Details

The data carry no substantive interpretation and serve only to exercise the package's linear, logistic, Cox, ordinal, multinomial and multilevel paths.
